map.📋 儿童贫血诊断标准 (WHO, 按年龄Hb阈值): Pediatric Anemia Criteria (WHO, age-based Hb thresholds)
map.提示：缺铁性贫血(IDA)是最常见的儿童贫血类型。铁缺乏分三期：1.铁减少期(S: Note: iron-deficiency anemia (IDA) is the most common pediatric anemia. Iron deficiency has 3 stages: 1. iron depletion (SF<12 μg/L, normal Hb); 2. iron-deficient erythropoiesis (SF<12, low MCV, normal Hb); 3. IDA (SF<12, low MCV, low Hb). First-line oral ferrous iron (elemental iron 3-6 mg/kg/day), between meals + vitamin C for absorption. Recheck Hb at 4 weeks; continue iron 2-3 months after correction to refill stores. Preterm infants: preventive iron 2 mg/kg/day from 2 weeks to 1 year. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.1 岁 Hb 阈值 110，90 为中度；铁蛋白<12、MCV<70→缺铁性，铁: 1 yo Hb threshold 110, 90 is moderate; ferritin<12, MCV<70 -> iron-deficient, iron 4 mg/kg×10 kg = 40 mg/day.
map.Hb<70 或心衰表现→考虑输血，稳定后铁剂+饮食干预。: Hb<70 or heart-failure signs -> consider transfusion; then iron + diet after stabilization.
map.治疗 3–6mg/kg/d 元素铁，预防 1–2mg/kg/d；餐间维 C 助吸: Treatment 3-6 mg/kg/d elemental iron, prevention 1-2 mg/kg/d; vitamin C between meals aids absorption.
map.小细胞低色素(低 MCV)支持缺铁，地贫则铁蛋白不低。: Microcytic hypochromic (low MCV) supports iron deficiency; in thalassemia ferritin is not low.
map.关于「缺铁性贫血(Hb血清铁蛋白)评估器」: About the Iron-Deficiency Anemia (Hb/Serum Ferritin) Assessor
map.儿童缺铁性贫血(Hb/血清铁蛋白)评估器，按年龄分层Hb阈值并评估铁缺乏程度与补: The pediatric IDA (Hb/serum ferritin) assessor uses age-stratified Hb thresholds to assess iron-deficiency degree and iron plan. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.小儿贫血按年龄分层 Hb 阈值(g/L)，采用 WHO 2024 指南：0–5月: Pediatric anemia uses age-specific Hb cutoffs (g/L) from WHO 2024: no WHO anemia definition at 0–5 months (physiological fluctuation; 100 g/L shown for reference only); 6–23 mo ≥105, 24–59 mo ≥110, 5–11 y ≥115, 12–14 y ≥120, ≥15 y women ≥120/men ≥130. WHO severity: below cutoff and ≥100 mild, 70–99 moderate, <70 severe (not a uniform 'cutoff − 10'). Iron deficiency has three stages: iron depletion (ID), iron-deficient erythropoiesis (IDE), iron-deficiency anemia (IDA, SF <12 μg/L with low Hb). Elemental iron = weight × 4 mg/day (treatment) or × 2 mg/day (prevention).
map.📖 原始文献/指南：World Health Organization. Gui: 📖 Source: World Health Organization. Guideline on haemoglobin cutoffs to define anaemia in individuals and populations. Geneva: WHO; 2024. | This 2024 edition supersedes WHO 2011 (WHO/NMH/NHD/MNM/11.1). Age- and sex-specific cutoffs: 6–23 mo <105 g/L, 24–59 mo <110, 5–11 y <115, 12–14 y <120, non-pregnant women ≥15 y <120, men ≥15 y <130 g/L; severity bands follow WHO 2011 (100 / 70 g/L).
map.儿童贫血诊断标准 (WHO 2024 Hb 阈值；严重度按 WHO 2011): Pediatric anemia diagnostic criteria (WHO 2024 Hb cutoffs; severity per WHO 2011)
map.注：WHO 2024 未对 <6 月龄定义贫血阈值（生理性 Hb 波动），本页: Note: WHO 2024 does not define an anemia cutoff below 6 months of age (physiological Hb fluctuation); the 100 g/L value for 0–5 months is for reference only and not diagnostic. Severity follows WHO 2011: mild 100 to cutoff − 1, moderate 70–99, severe <70 g/L. Iron-deficiency anemia (IDA) is the most common pediatric anemia.

Prefer oral ferrous iron (elemental iron 3–6 mg/kg/day) between meals with vitamin C. Recheck Hb at 4 weeks; after correction continue iron for 2–3 months to replenish stores. Preterm infants: preventive iron 2 mg/kg/day from 2 weeks to 1 year. For clinical reference only.
map.1 岁属 6–23 月档，Hb 阈值 105；Hb 90 为中度贫血（70–99: At 1 year (6–23 mo band) the Hb cutoff is 105; Hb 90 is moderate anemia (70–99); ferritin <12 and MCV <70 indicate iron deficiency; iron 4 mg/kg × 10 kg = 40 mg/day.
